newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria budget deficit up to 485 bln levs in May.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria budget deficit up to 485 bln levs in May.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit rose by some 93 billion levs ($55.7 million) in the second half of May to 485.22 billion levs for the year so far, a Finance Ministry official cited early estimates as showing.
"The deficit rose to 485.22 billion levs on May 31 mainly due to interest and discount payments on government securities," the official, who declined to be named told Reuters.
The Finance ministry made a total of around 101 billion levs interest and discount payments on government securities in the second half of May, Finance ministry figures showed.

Deficit at end-May was around three percent of the nominal draft 1997 Gross Domestic Product (GDP), almost half of the 6.2 percent draft budget deficit assumed for this year. Projected GDP is seen at 16.15 trillion levs with revenues seen at 27.3 percent of GDP and expenditures at 33.5 percent.
Budget revenues at end-May amounted to 685.39 billion levs or 4.24 percent of projected GDP. Expenditures stood at 1,170.61 billion levs, which is 7.25 percent of GDP.
Bulgaria's cabinet and parliament have yet to approve this year's budget.
